serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Ah!
…
It’s such a weird feeling…
Appearing here and getting all the memories back…
“Getting them back” is not a good way of describing it. It’s more like realizing something obvious.
It’s like looking for something and then, after a while, finding out it was in your hand the whole time…
This whole thing is not normal at all. I should probably stop, but whatever I think about right now will be forgotten anyway.
There’s no way for me to leave any message or anything like that. It sucks. 
It’s pointless to struggle now. I need to beat whoever appears and get it done. The quicker, the better. 
Mrs. Fisher says it’s safe, but you never can be too careful about unregulated psychedelics that were given to you by a mysterious fisherwoman you barely know.
